profile_text.body:
Twilio describes itself as a communications and conversational AI platform. Per its site, it offers APIs for SMS, RCS, voice, and email, along with conversational AI and identity verification. The company says the platform connects communication channels, customer context, and AI in one place, and frames the offering around what it calls the agentic era, where humans and AI agents coordinate across channels and hand conversations to people when complexity or customer intent requires it, with context carried over so customers do not repeat themselves. Twilio says AI agents draw on internal knowledge and real-time data, and it advertises flexible plans with pay-as-you-go pricing.

The company is a public company headquartered in San Francisco, California, trading under the ticker TWLO, with CIK 0001447669. No products or MCP servers are listed for it in the material reviewed here.

Its recorded law exposure is in California, with a count of 281. No individual cases are listed.
